claim_limits: The 50 m candidate is a numerical reference, not observed ground truth.
Passing criteria justify only the declared quantities and conclusions.
Cell-level peaks remain diagnostic when convergence assumptions fail.
Event-effect percentages and centroids are evaluated only while excess mass is at least 1 percent of its episode peak.
Temporal information loss includes unresolved evolution between persisted outputs, not only shared instants and peaks.
Effective mixing height is a constant 200 m provisional approximation for the thesis scope.
